description: End-to-end SD-WAN migration workflow for B2B customers, covering discovery, design, validation, change execution, rollback, and post-migration assurance.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the B2B customer

migration_id.description: Unique identifier for an SD-WAN migration project

service_id.description: Identifier for an SD-WAN service instance

change_window_id.description: Identifier for a scheduled change window

task_id.description: Identifier for a workflow task within the migration project

rollback_plan_id.description: Identifier for a rollback plan associated with a migration or site

config_diff.description: Represents configuration differences between current and target states

current_config.description: Sanitized current configuration blob or reference

target_config.description: Sanitized target configuration blob or reference

functions.name: create_migration_project
functions.description: Create a new SD-WAN migration project for a B2B customer, defining scope and initial parameters.

project_name.description: Human-friendly name for the migration project

scope.description: Definition of migration scope across sites and services

included_sites.description: Explicit list of site IDs to include

site_filters.description: Filters to dynamically select sites if explicit list not provided

target_platform.description: SD-WAN platform that will host the migrated services

governance.description: Governance and compliance requirements for the migration

blackout_periods.description: Time ranges during which changes are forbidden

metadata.description: Custom metadata or labels for the project

functions.returns: New migration_id with initial project metadata and status

functions.name: discover_current_topology
functions.description: Discover the customer's current WAN topology and associated services for the migration scope.

discovery_strategy.description: Preferred method to discover existing topology

site_batches.description: Optional explicit batches of sites to discover

functions.returns: Discovery task_id, summary of discovered sites/services, and potential gaps

functions.name: generate_migration_design
functions.description: Generate target SD-WAN design and site-level migration plans based on discovered topology.

design_policies.description: High-level design policies to apply to the target architecture

preferred_underlay_priority.description: Ordered list of preferred underlay types

per_site_overrides.description: Overrides and special handling rules for specific sites

functions.returns: Design task_id, generated high-level and per-site migration plans with risk classification

functions.name: validate_migration_feasibility
functions.description: Validate feasibility and risks of the generated migration design against technical and business constraints.

custom_checks.description: Optional list of additional custom validation checks

sites_subset.description: Optional subset of sites to validate (defaults to all planned sites)

functions.returns: Validation task_id, feasibility status, list of blocking/non-blocking issues and recommended remediations

functions.name: schedule_migration_change_window
functions.description: Schedule change windows for SD-WAN migration across sites or batches, respecting governance policies.

scheduling_mode.description: Whether to automatically compute windows or use explicitly provided ones

auto_options.description: Options for automatically scheduling change windows (used when scheduling_mode=auto)

start_after.description: Earliest allowed start time in UTC

end_before.description: Latest allowed end time in UTC

manual_windows.description: Explicit change windows per site or site group (used when scheduling_mode=manual)

functions.returns: List of created change_window_id entries with associated sites and status (planned/pending_approval)

functions.name: create_rollback_plan
functions.description: Create or update rollback plans for the migration at global, batch, or per-site level.

scope.description: Scope at which the rollback plan applies

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute during rollback

functions.returns: rollback_plan_id with scope details and validation status

functions.name: execute_migration_batch
functions.description: Execute SD-WAN migration for a batch of sites within a scheduled change window.

change_window_id.description: Change window within which the batch will be executed

sites.description: List of sites to migrate in this execution

sequence.description: Order in which the site should be migrated within the batch

custom_parameters.description: Site-specific flags (e.g., reduced MTU, custom QoS)

pre_checks.description: Additional pre-checks to run before executing the batch

functions.returns: Execution task_id, per-site execution status, and any auto-triggered rollback_plan_id references

functions.name: get_migration_status
functions.description: Retrieve aggregated status of a migration project, including per-site and per-task states.

include.description: Optional additional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Current migration overall status, progress percentages, and optional detailed site/task/change_window information

functions.name: retry_failed_site_migration
functions.description: Retry migration for specific sites that previously failed or were rolled back.

override_params.description: Optional override parameters for retry (e.g., disable some checks)

change_window_id.description: Existing or new change window to host this retry; if omitted, auto-selected according to policies

functions.returns: Retry task_id per site and updated site-level migration statuses

functions.name: rollback_migration_scope
functions.description: Trigger rollback for a specific scope (site, change window, or entire migration) using an existing rollback plan.

change_window_id.description: Change window to rollback (required when scope=change_window)

rollback_plan_id.description: If not provided, the system selects the most specific applicable rollback plan

approval.description: Approval metadata for the rollback action

approved_by.description: User or system that approved the rollback

ticket_reference.description: External change or incident ticket reference

functions.returns: Rollback execution task_id, affected site list, and resulting state per site

functions.name: compare_pre_post_migration_metrics
functions.description: Compare key performance and configuration metrics before and after migration to assess success and impact.

sites.description: Optional subset of sites; if omitted, all migrated sites are considered

time_windows.description: Time ranges for pre- and post-migration analysis

config_diff_options.description: Options for comparing configs pre- and post-migration

functions.returns: Per-site metric comparison summary, list of config_diff objects, and identification of SLA regressions

functions.name: get_site_migration_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed migration information for a specific site, including tasks, configs, and events.

include.description: Sections to include in the details response

pagination.description: Pagination options for large event/task logs

functions.returns: Complete migration timeline and status for the site, including related task_ids and any rollback_plan_id references

functions.name: closeout_migration_project
functions.description: Perform migration closeout activities, finalize documentation, and optionally decommission legacy services.

legacy_service_ids.description: List of legacy service_id values to decommission, if applicable

customer_signoff.description: Customer signoff details for the migration

functions.returns: Final migration status, closure timestamp, references to generated reports, and any decommission tasks

functions.name: search_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Faceted search across SD-WAN migration projects with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of SD-WAN migration project summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Create multiple SD-WAN migration projects in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created SD-WAN migration project ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many SD-WAN migration projects with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each SD-WAN migration project, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many SD-WAN migration projects in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each SD-WAN migration project, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Export SD-WAN migration project datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Bulk-import SD-WAN migration project records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated SD-WAN migration projects.

functions.name: subscribe_to_sd_wan_migration_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive SD-WAN migration project lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_migration_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a SD-WAN migration project, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the SD-WAN migration project, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_sd_wan_migration_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for SD-WAN migration projects using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the SD-WAN migration project action.

functions.name: simulate_sd_wan_migration_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a SD-WAN migration project without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the SD-WAN migration project, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_sd_wan_migration_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a SD-WAN migration project change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the SD-WAN migration project under change.

functions.name: decide_sd_wan_migration_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending SD-WAN migration project approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: add_sd_wan_migration_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a SD-WAN migration project for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: upload_sd_wan_migration_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a SD-WAN migration project with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_migration_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a SD-WAN migration project (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the SD-WAN migration project version captured.

functions.name: restore_sd_wan_migration_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a SD-WAN migration project from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_migration_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for SD-WAN migration projects over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the SD-WAN migration project domain context.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_migration_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for SD-WAN migration projects combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the SD-WAN migration project context.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_migration_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to SD-WAN migration projects with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current SD-WAN migration projects.

functions.name: evaluate_sd_wan_migration_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a SD-WAN migration project in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_migration_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a SD-WAN migration project including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the SD-WAN migration project, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_sd_wan_migration_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a SD-WAN migration project and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: assign_sd_wan_migration_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a SD-WAN migration project with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the SD-WAN migration project with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_sd_wan_migrations
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more SD-WAN migration projects, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each SD-WAN migration project.

functions.name: compare_sd_wan_migration_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a SD-WAN migration project with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the SD-WAN migration project, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_sd_wan_migration_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to SD-WAN migration project operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of SD-WAN migration project operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_sd_wan_migration_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a SD-WAN migration project and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the SD-WAN migration project, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_sd_wan_migration
functions.description: Clone a SD-WAN migration project into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned SD-WAN migration project record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_sd_wan_migration_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted SD-WAN migration project report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the SD-WAN migration project window covered.

functions.name: escalate_sd_wan_migration
functions.description: Escalate a SD-WAN migration project to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the SD-WAN migration project.
